course.title: Primary Industries
course.framework: NESA Primary Industries Curriculum Framework based on AHCv11

purpose: Help students distinguish supplementary learning, authorised RTO competency assessment, HSC examination and work-placement records, then reach the current controlled system named by their teacher/RTO.

boundaries.supplementarySite: This site provides supplementary learning and formative practice. Only the authorised RTO assessment process and a qualified assessor can determine competency.
boundaries.learningRecord: Saved website checks and activities are formative learning records, not RTO submissions, work-placement hours or competency decisions.
boundaries.hscExam: The external HSC examination reports achievement against HSC examination standards; it does not by itself determine RTO competency or qualification eligibility.
boundaries.taskGroupNumbering: Learning group numbers organise this website only. They do not assert formal assessment task numbering.
boundaries.controlledAuthority: The current signed TAS, RTO student task, approved notification and authorised system control every formal assessment detail.
